contentHtml:
Admissions are now open for UK MRCOG & MRCPCH Sponsorship Programme for its upcoming batches

Cloudnine Group of Hospitals, India’s leading premium birthing centre in India in collaboration with BAPIO (British Association of Physicians of Indian Origin), is inviting applications for the upcoming batches of its UK MRCOG and MRCPCH Sponsorship Programme.

Designed for MBBS, MD/MS, and DNB-qualified doctors, the programme aims to support aspiring specialists in Obstetrics & Gynaecology and Paediatrics through structured academic training, clinical exposure, and mentorship from experienced clinicians. The initiative is focused on helping doctors pursue globally recognized qualifications while enhancing their clinical expertise and career prospects.

This three-year programme offers participants a unique opportunity to learn from experts, gain hands-on experience, and align their practice with international standards of women’s and child healthcare.

Speaking at the sidelines of the initiative, Dr Naga Nischal, Head of Clinical Services says, “At Cloudnine, we believe that continuous medical learning is fundamental to delivering the best patient outcomes. Through the MRCOG and MRCPCH Sponsorship Programme, we aim to empower the next generation of specialists with access to structured learning, expert mentorship, and globally relevant clinical exposure. Our goal is to nurture healthcare professionals who can contribute meaningfully to advancing women’s and children’s healthcare.”

Adding further, Dr Nischal says “The programme is particularly relevant for doctors seeking to enhance their academic credentials, broaden their clinical perspectives, and pursue internationally recognized pathways in reproductive, maternal, neonatal, and child healthcare.

Programme Highlights

  • UK MRCOG/MRCPCH Sponsorship Programme in association with BAPIO
  • Open to MBBS, MD/MS, and DNB-qualified doctors meeting eligibility criteria
  • Structured academic training and mentorship
  • Clinical placement opportunities
  • Guidance from experienced clinicians and educators
  • Duration: 3 Years
  • Focus on Obstetrics & Gynaecology and Paediatrics
